items.title: Volkswagen's controlling families weigh in on restructuring battle, call for swift action
items.summary: Volkswagen ​CEO Oliver Blume has pledged to drastically overhaul the group - which includes the VW mass-market business, premium brands Porsche and Audi, and luxury marque Lamborghini - as it battles high costs, tariff woes and intensifying competition from China.

items.title: Audi India offers free 24x7 roadside assistance to rain-hit cars in Delhi-NCR
items.summary: The service will be available 24x7 across Delhi-NCR, with Audi India saying its teams are on standby to respond to customers affected by the weather conditions.

items.title: Volkswagen owners urge urgent action to cut costs, fend off China rivals
items.summary: Volkswagen's controlling families are urging management to act now. They emphasize the company's historic crossroads and need for sustainable competitiveness. Excess capacity must be reduced and costs significantly lowered. Decision-making processes need strengthening to address growing problems. This comes as Porsche SE reported a drop in its adjusted half-year earnings.

items.title: Bolt.Earth Secures ARAI Certification for Universal Fast Charger
items.summary: Bolt.Earth announced on Tuesday that it has received certification from the Automotive Research Association of India (ARAI) for its Blaze DC 3kW Dual Gun Charger, validating the unit for two- and three-wheeler electric vehicles across India. The certification marks the Blaze DC 3kW Dual Gun as the world's first universal fast charger for two- and three-wheelers to meet ARAI safety and performance standards.

items.title: BharatBenz Opens Regional Parts Logistics Centre in Pune
items.summary: Daimler India Commercial Vehicles (DICV), which manufactures BharatBenz trucks and buses, has inaugurated a new West Regional Parts Logistics Centre in Pune as part of efforts to strengthen its aftersales and spare-parts distribution network. The facility is intended to bring genuine spare parts closer to customers and dealers in western India, helping reduce delivery lead times and improve parts availability.

items.title: Mercedes, BMW, Volkswagen, Audi and Porsche are losing China to EV upstarts
items.summary: Homegrown brands like Xiaomi and BYD are making significant inroads with consumers. The challenge for these foreign automakers lies in adjusting their pricing strategies and keeping pace with swift advancements in electric vehicle technology. To reclaim their luxury status and financial health, German firms need to innovate at an accelerated pace.
